Hai Ha Confectionery Joint Stock Company (HHC), established in 1960, specializes in the production and trading of confectionery. HHC is one of the three largest confectionery manufacturers in Vietnam, accounting for approximately 6% of the national confectionery market, with a production scale of about 20,000 tons/year.
